stage0014_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$シン$$
「Unidentified mobile suit over there...
　respond to us!」

stage0014_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$ギルボア$$
「Guess we got spotted...
　That's a $$プラント$$ patrol squad, huh.」

stage0014_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$シン$$
「That unit... Neo Zeon, huh!
　But hiding out in a place like this,
　they must've been planning a terror attack!」

stage0014_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$シン$$
「All units, prepare to attack!
　Capture them, and pry out their whole plan!」

stage0014_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$シン$$
「Was that attack a Dragoon, or a Fang...!?
　No, a Funnel!」

stage0014_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$シン$$
「So it was them who wiped out our squad!」

stage0014_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「The surprise attack thinned their forces.
　Now we just finish off the last one.」

stage0014_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「I know.
　That's... a Gundam.」

stage0014_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$シン$$
「Damn it!
　Looks like I'll have to do this alone!」

stage0014_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$シン$$
「Here I come, terrorists!
　I don't care if you're Neo Zeon or not!」

stage0014_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$シン$$
「If war's the only path you'll take,
　then I'll be your opponent!」

stage0014_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$マリーダ$$
（Master... how are things on your end...）

stage0014_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「This is bad, $$ギルボア$$...!
　The Federation's here!」

stage0014_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$ギルボア$$
「Tch...!
　So the L3 crew failed to hold them off!」

stage0014_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$シン$$
「No time to celebrate, huh!
　Lend a hand taking down these terrorists!」

stage0014_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$リディ$$
「So that's $$カミーユ$$'s friend, the 《$$赤服$$》.」

stage0014_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「His name is $$シン・アスカ$$.
　He pilots $$ザフト$$'s Gundam, the Destiny.」

stage0014_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$n
「That Neo Zeon mobile suit...
　is it trying to seize the colony?」

stage0014_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Doesn't look that way to me...」

stage0014_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Well, one thing's for sure...
　this is what $$トロワ$$ was trying to warn us about.」

stage0014_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$レイアム$$
「What are your orders, Captain?」

stage0014_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$オットー$$
「Crushing terrorists is our mission.
　Order all units to attack.」

stage0014_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$レイアム$$
「And what about Mr. $$アルベルト$$?」

stage0014_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$オットー$$
「He's the one who wanted to go to Industrial 7.
　Lt. Colonel $$ダグザ$$ is with him, so just leave it be.」

stage0014_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$オットー$$
「Still, that man... roping in $$エコーズ$$, huh...」

stage0014_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$ギルボア$$
「That ship... looks like it's Londo Bell.」

stage0014_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「An independent unit, said to be handpicked elites.
　We can't afford to underestimate them.」

stage0014_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「But until Master gets his hands on the Box,
　there's no retreat for us...!」

stage0014_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「The $$キュベレイ$$...!
　$$ハマーン・カーン$$'s come herself!」

stage0014_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$n
「Still, for Neo Zeon's leader
　to come out onto the battlefield alone...」

stage0014_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Don't let it trouble you, $$マリーダ$$.
　Keeping that one's whims in check
　is my job, isn't it?」

stage0014_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「Then, allow me to accompany you.」

stage0014_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「I'll be expecting much, $$マリーダ・クルス$$.」

stage0014_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$リディ$$
「If we bring down $$ハマーン$$ here,
　we can curb Neo Zeon's anti-Federation drive...!」

stage0014_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$オットー$$
「I-in a chance encounter like this,
　the world's future gets decided...!?」

stage0014_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ハマーン$$...!
　Just what are you thinking...!?」

stage0014_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Heh... once that man learns of the Princess's
　desperate resolve, he may see his own failings.」

stage0014_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Get out...!
　Get ouuuut of heeere!!」

stage0014_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Get some distance, $$マリーダ$$!」

stage0014_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$レイアム$$
「But it does seem to have the will
　to fight Neo Zeon, at least.」

stage0014_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$シン$$
「But those movements... they're like an amateur's!」

stage0014_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「This feeling... it's the same as on Earth...」

stage0014_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$シン$$! Cover that machine for me!」

stage0014_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
Shinn
「Pilot of the white mobile suit, can you hear me!
　I'm $$シン・アスカ$$, I'll be covering you!」

stage0014_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I have to do this...!
　There's no choice but to do it...!」

stage0014_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$シン$$
「This guy...!
　Isn't listening to a word I say...!?」

stage0014_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「What will you do, Your Excellency?」

stage0014_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Drag this fight out more, and it'll cause trouble.
　We withdraw in 6 minutes.」

stage0014_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「The Princess is $$ジンネマン$$'s charge.」

stage0014_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「What will you do, Your Excellency?」

stage0014_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Drag this fight out more, and it'll cause trouble.
　We withdraw in 5 minutes.」

stage0014_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「The Princess is $$ジンネマン$$'s charge.」

stage0014_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「What will you do, Your Excellency?」

stage0014_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Drag this fight out more, and it'll cause trouble.
　We withdraw in 4 minutes.」

stage0014_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「The Princess is $$ジンネマン$$'s charge.」

stage0014_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「What will you do, Your Excellency?」

stage0014_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Drag this fight out more, and it'll cause trouble.
　We withdraw in 3 minutes.」

stage0014_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「The Princess is $$ジンネマン$$'s charge.」

stage0014_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$オットー$$
「Confirming the situation comes later!
　First, we get through this!」

stage0014_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$オットー$$
「All units, protect the white mobile suit
　while striking down Neo Zeon!」

stage0014_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$シン$$
「Here we go, you...!
　You ready!?」

stage0014_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「Grr...!
　At least confirm where the Princess is...!」

stage0014_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「Out of time...!
　But at least confirm where the Princess is...!」

stage0014_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$シン$$
「That guy...!
　Is he trying to breach the colony!?」

stage0014_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I won't let you do that...!」

stage0014_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
Marida
「This is as far as I go...!
　$$マリーダ・クルス$$, falling back!」

stage0014_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「That white mobile suit...!
　A new Gundam...!」

stage0014_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$ハマーン$$
（But what is this...?
　This ominous air he's giving off...）

stage0014_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$デュオ$$
「The one-horned mystery unit shifted... no, morphed!」

stage0014_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$シン$$! The pilot's out cold!
　Recover that Gundam!」

stage0014_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$オットー$$
「...Damn it, what's going on here...」

stage0014_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Captain, Mr. $$アルベルト$$ has requested recovery.」

stage0014_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$オットー$$
「That man...!
　Only turns to us at times like this...!」

stage0014_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$オットー$$
「Send someone suitable to recover it!
　The rest, check Industrial 7's damage!」

stage0014_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$オットー$$
「Hurry it up!
　If we're not careful, Neo Zeon's pursuit force
　will come after us!」

stage0014_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$オットー$$
「Once we've done the bare minimum,
　we're pulling out of here at once!」

stage0014_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「...How pathetic.
　Is this all born of the doubt in me?」

stage0014_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「Your Excellency, let me handle the rest...!」

stage0014_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Sorry, $$マリーダ$$.
　I leave the rest to you.」

stage0014_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ハマーン・カーン$$...
　Do you want to drag the Earth Sphere into war...?」

stage0014_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（But I don't understand...
　Why did $$ハマーン$$ bother sortieing herself...）

stage0014_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（This battle... does it really mean that much...）

stage0014_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$ギルボア$$
「Tch...! Screwed up, did I!」

stage0014_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「Fall back, $$ギルボア$$!
　I'll take it from here!」

stage0014_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$ギルボア$$
「Sorry, $$マリーダ$$!
　Don't push yourself too hard either!」

stage0014_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$シン$$
「Damn it...!
　Why is Neo Zeon trying to start a war!」

stage0014_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$シン$$
「At this rate, it's war all over again!
　Do you people even understand that!」

stage0014_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「A $$ザフト$$ Gundam...!
　Get in our way, and I show no mercy!」

stage0014_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$シン$$
「What are you talking about!
　You're the ones standing in peace's way!」

stage0014_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$シン$$
「I've had enough of war!
　If you won't see that, I'll stop you myself!」

stage0014_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「I remember you.
　The boy who stayed loyal to Gilbert 《$$デュランダル$$》
　and fought at his side to the end.」

stage0014_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$シン$$
「I'm not who I was back then!
　I've learned to think and decide what's right myself!」

stage0014_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Then answer me this.
　Is fighting us now the right thing to do?」

stage0014_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$シン$$
「My fight is to put an end to fighting!
　If you're the ones starting this war,
　then stopping you is the fight I've chosen!」

stage0014_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Very well, boy.
　For that purity, I'll face you myself!」

stage0014_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「This feeling...!
　The pilot's an Enhanced Human!」

stage0014_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「You can sense me...!
　But that's as far as you go!」

stage0014_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Not just him, now another Enhanced Human too...!
　Is Neo Zeon turning people into tools of war!」

stage0014_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Do you still not understand
　how much sorrow that creates!」

stage0014_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ハマーン・カーン$$!」

stage0014_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「I remember you, boy.
　To think we'd meet on the battlefield again.」

stage0014_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Is Neo Zeon challenging the Federation to war!?」

stage0014_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「That isn't mine to decide.」

stage0014_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「I can feel your doubt as clear as day...!
　It seems you and I are alike in some way!」

stage0014_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Like I'd fall for that taunt...!
　I'll shoot you down and stop this war!」

stage0014_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Charging in blindly won't cut it, $n!
　They've read our movements completely!」

stage0014_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$n
「But there's nothing else I can do right now...!」

stage0014_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「You amateur...!
　This is what happens when a novice shows up...!」

stage0014_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$n
「Novice or not, amateur or not, I won't die!
　Whatever it takes, I'll survive!」

stage0014_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「It seems a fine unit,
　but the pilot in it is far too green.」

stage0014_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$スズネ$$
「That's $$ハマーン・カーン$$...!
　Neo Zeon's leader!」

stage0014_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$n
「If I bring her down,
　there won't be a war between Earth and the colonies...!
　Then I'll fight like my life depends on it!」

stage0014_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Heh... the battlefield isn't kind enough
　to be won on passion alone, boy...!」

stage0014_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「You think a unit like that
　can match my $$クシャトリヤ$$!」

stage0014_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「A machine's spec doesn't decide a battle.
　Not knowing that, you can't beat me.」

stage0014_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Matching my $$キュベレイ$$ in that machine
　is quite the feat.」

stage0014_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I don't intend to settle for even.」

stage0014_04:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Heh... beneath that machine-like calm,
　I sense a strong will...
　You're quite the pilot, boy...!」

stage0014_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Why...!
　Why does anyone fight a war like this!?」

stage0014_04:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Get out of here, all of you!
　Nobody wants a war like this!」

stage0014_04:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$バナージ$$
（That four-winged mobile suit...!
　Is it the core of their force!）

stage0014_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$マリーダ$$
（What is this feeling...!
　Am I being overwhelmed
　by that pilot's pressure...!?）

stage0014_04:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「That mobile suit's presence...!
　Something in me says it's dangerous...!」

stage0014_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Even I can tell...!
　That mobile suit's strength is on another level...!」

stage0014_04:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「An amateur's piloting it...!
　Then I'll strike now while I can!」

stage0014_04:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Am I going down...!?
　No, I didn't come out here to lose!」

stage0014_04:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I have to do this...!
　With this power entrusted to me...!」
